facts.value: The routine does nothing unless generator data is installed and the global enable flag is set. Within an enabled scan, disabled entries have marker or cooldown `-1`, occupied entries have a non-null object, delayed vacant entries have a positive cooldown that is decremented once, and spawn-ready entries have no object and cooldown zero.
